utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — Saturday at 9 a.m. on the front porch would be perfect. If you can, please help sort the donated tools and set them out for people to grab.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll be there Saturday at 9 a.m. and I’ll sort the donated tools and set them out on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — I’m still sorting the exact time and supplies, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — just let me know when you’ve got the time, and I’ll keep the front porch repair drive lined up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 9 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday works for me — I’ll be there to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 9 a.m. on the front porch Saturday works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll be there Sunday at 9 a.m. at the community center to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — can we stick to 9 a.m. on the front porch? I want to make sure the timing and place are right for the setup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina — 10 a.m. on the front porch works. I’ll have a simple sorting task ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 10 a.m. on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — could you come by around 9 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive? If you can make it, I’ll let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can be there at 9 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday. Let me know what to bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — I’m still pinning down the exact time, but I’ll send you a reminder as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Tess — just send me the reminder when you know the time, and I’ll be there for the repair drive.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
